# Code to video: prototype a shot in three.js or Blender before Seedance

**A brief, reference clip or painting becomes a 3D scene staged in metres, checked frames and a guide clip for a video model.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_7eb2082066a4.webp" alt="A coded 3D previz: blocky stand-in characters and props are staged in grey sets while a camera view and the shot code sit side by side." width="480"></p>

Prototype a video in code with an agent. Decides if a shot needs a 3D prototype at all and which tool fits (Three.js, Blender, a phone act-out, storyboards, Remotion, Cinema 4D, Unreal), stages geometry, people, camera and light in real metres, copies a reference video shot by shot with a solved 3D camera, stages a shot from a painting or still, invents one when there is no reference, checks everything with numbers and frames, and writes the handoff to Seedance or other video models. Same scene file renders in Three.js and headless Blender. Use for "previz", "blockout", "3D animatic", "three.js or blender", "prototype this video", "copy this shot", "recreate this video in 3D", "stage this painting", "camera blocking with Claude or Codex", "code to video", "rank takes", "LLM judge", or when generated shots keep drifting. Not for a full multi-shot three.js film with a review UI (threejs-animatic, varg-previz), prompting a shot with no prototype (varg-video-prompting) or the full animation pass (video-animate).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill code-to-video-previz                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills code-to-video-previz --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 82 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

|---|---|
| Makes | staging.json, checked stills, guide clip |
| Needs | nothing paid: runs locally |
| Uses | three.js, Blender, Python, Bun, Chrome, FFmpeg, uv, Seedance 2.5 |

| Agent instructions | [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) (v1.0.1) |

## Ask your agent

- "Recreate ./ref.mp4 in 3D with a solved camera so Seedance copies the move"
- "Does this drone-over-the-harbour shot need a 3D prototype? If so, stage it in three.js in real metres"
- "Stage the composition of painting.jpg as a 3D shot and render a guide clip in headless Blender"
